sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.

2. By means of this application, the Petitioner seeks grant of bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 417/376(2)(n)/294/354/323/506/
313/341/109/34 of I.P.C.
3.
Perusal of the FIR reveals that the Informant has a love relationship with the Pradip Parichha since last two years.
On 20.03.2023, the said Pradip Parichaa assured her to marry took her and kept in a rented house instead of taking her to his house and kept physical relationship with the Informant for fifteen days.
Thereafter the he left the Informant and went to his house where his parents reside.
The Informant informed this matter to her family members, they all went to the house of the Petitioner, and there the present Petitioners abused them in obscene languages.
It is further alleged that the elder brother of the Pradip Parichha tried to outrage // 2 // the modesty of the Informant and assaulted her by dragging her hair.

4. Keeping in view the submission and the nature of allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the circumstances appearing, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant the anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail in connection with C.T. Case No.191 of 2023 arising out of Raikia P.S. Case No.36 of 2023 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C., G. Udayagiri within a period of three weeks hence they shall be admitted to bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court with further conditions that the Petitioners shall appear in person before the learned Seberian Parichha @ Sebrian vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109235577/
1 court below on each date of posting of the case unless specifically exempted by the court concerned and/or consider the prayer U/s.317 Cr.P.C; shall appear before the I.O. as and when required and shall cooperate with the investigation; shall not threaten, intimidate or terrorize the informant; shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever, while on bail.
5. Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
6. The ABLAPL stands disposed of accordingly.
